problem_text:
A telecommunications firm must interconnect seven regional data hubs with fiber optic cables.

The required cable lengths between hubs are as follows:
* Hub 1 to Hub 2: 99.5 km
* Hub 1 to Hub 3: 79.5 km
* Hub 1 to Hub 4: 30.9 km
* Hub 1 to Hub 5: 33.5 km
* Hub 1 to Hub 6: 96.2 km
* Hub 1 to Hub 7: 31.6 km
* Hub 2 to Hub 3: 153.1 km
* Hub 2 to Hub 4: 112.1 km
* Hub 2 to Hub 5: 66.1 km
* Hub 2 to Hub 6: 122.5 km
* Hub 2 to Hub 7: 127.6 km
* Hub 3 to Hub 4: 49.5 km
* Hub 3 to Hub 5: 97.4 km
* Hub 3 to Hub 6: 174.3 km
* Hub 3 to Hub 7: 55.2 km
* Hub 4 to Hub 5: 50.0 km
* Hub 4 to Hub 6: 127.0 km
* Hub 4 to Hub 7: 22.7 km
* Hub 5 to Hub 6: 97.4 km
* Hub 5 to Hub 7: 62.0 km
* Hub 6 to Hub 7: 120.2 km

The network engineer must determine the most efficient closed-loop inspection tour, where each hub is visited precisely once before returning to the origin, minimizing the total cable traversal distance.
